name: appium-js-framework
description: Appium mobile test automation framework using WebdriverIO + JavaScript

scripts.test:login-watchlist:resume: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:RESUME_SESSION='1'; wdio run ./config/wdio.android.conf.js --suite login-watchlist 2>&1 | Tee-Object ('logs/test-login-watchlist-resume-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.log')"
scripts.test:quote:resume: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:RESUME_SESSION='1'; wdio run ./config/wdio.android.conf.js --suite quote 2>&1 | Tee-Object ('logs/test-quote-resume-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.log')"
scripts.test:search:resume: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:RESUME_SESSION='1'; wdio run ./config/wdio.android.conf.js --suite search 2>&1 | Tee-Object ('logs/test-search-resume-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.log')"
scripts.test:report: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.appium:setup: appium driver install uiautomator2 && appium driver install xcuitest
